title.value: A debriefing tool to acquire non-technical skills in trauma courses
title.justification: The paper primarily focuses on describing a tool and methodology aimed at improving the acquisition of non-technical skills in trauma courses, which is highlighted in the title.
title.quote: A debriefing tool to acquire non-technical skills in trauma courses

extractions.description: The paper evaluates the use of the PEARLS Healthcare Debriefing Tool within trauma simulation courses to develop non-technical skills such as communication, decision-making, leadership, and teamwork. It reports on the creation of a specific debriefing tool card for trauma scenarios, aiming to structure and improve the debriefing process in trauma education, with a focus on non-technical skills.

primary_category.justification: The paper is focused on educational methodologies in medical training, specifically related to trauma care and non-technical skills development, which does not directly relate to any of the eco-responsible categories provided.
primary_category.quote: A debriefing tool to acquire non-technical skills in trauma courses

primary_sub_category.justification: As the paper does not relate to any environmental or climate-related sub-category, the appropriate choice is 'N/A'. The paper focuses on educational approaches rather than ecological implications.
primary_sub_category.quote: The study reports the use of a nominal group technique (NGT) to evaluate the PEARLS Healthcare debriefing tool as a tool to foster non-technical skills in trauma simulation courses.

new_primary_category.justification: The paper's focus is on educational tools and methodologies designed to enhance medical training, particularly in trauma and non-technical skills. This is distinct from the environmental and climate categories provided and warrants a separate classification.
new_primary_category.quote: A debriefing tool to acquire non-technical skills in trauma courses

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The paper specifically addresses methods to enhance trauma education through the integration of non-technical skills training, which is not covered by the existing sub-categories related to ecological impact.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: A specific debriefing tool for trauma scenarios was designed based on these suggestions, which is presented in this article.
